title: Probe: runner, VideoToolbox / ImageIO / AudioToolbox tests, launchd job
done: probe/probe_core.h: exactly the frozen interface (probe_ctx, probe_say, probe_test, probe_run, probe_now_ns, probe_fill_nv12, probe_psnr, probe_md5).

probe/probe_core.c: each test in a forked child; child->parent fields over a pipe with 8-byte big-endian length framing (so a value may contain any byte); parent deadline kills with SIGKILL and reports 'timeout'; results pass/fail/skip/timeout/crash; one JSON object per test appended and fsync'ed; one JSON-escaped 'fields' object; one 'N2VIDEO probe: <name> <result> <3 fields>' line to /dev/console opened per line (N2VIDEO_CONSOLE overrides the path for the host test); MD5 from RFC 1321 written from the standard; probe_fill_nv12 and probe_psnr exactly as specified; probe_next_index(dir) = 1 + highest probe-<n>.jsonl (declared by probe_main.c and test/t_core.c, deliberately not in the frozen header).

probe/probe_main.c: exits 0 silently unless /private/var/db/nord2-video-probe exists; sleeps 45 s unless argv has --now; creates /private/var/db/nord2-video; writes probe-<n>.jsonl (n from probe_next_index); header line {"probe":"wp07-1.0","kind":"header",time,time_iso,sysname,release,machine,pid}; runs probe_vt_tests, probe_img_tests, probe_audio_tests and (unless -DPROBE_NO_AV) probe_av_tests; final console+stderr line 'N2VIDEO probe: DONE pass=.. fail=.. skip=.. crash=.. file=..'; end line {"kind":"end",...}. Exit status is 0 even when tests fail (a failure is a measurement); 1 only if the output file cannot be written.

probe/probe_apple.h: hand-written declarations of the VideoToolbox, ImageIO/CoreGraphics and AudioToolbox calls and of dlopen/dlsym/dlerror plus CFDataCreate*/CFDataGetLength. No Apple SDK header is included.

probe/probe_vt.c T01 'vt.encoders': VTCopyVideoEncoderList; per entry codec four chars, EncoderID, EncoderName, DisplayName, IsHardwareAccelerated (key by dlsym with a literal fallback); keys CodecType/EncoderID/EncoderName/DisplayName from the exported kVTVideoEncoderList_* constants.

probe/probe_vt.c T02 'vt.decode.{avc1,hvc1,av01,mp4v}': builds the format description from WP09's parameter sets (H.264 via CMVideoFormatDescriptionCreateFromH264ParameterSets, HEVC via ...FromHEVCParameterSets), VTDecompressionSessionCreate with {PixelFormatType: 420v}, decodes every embedded AVCC access unit, WaitForAsynchronousFrames; reports create/session/wait status, frames in/out, per-frame status, md5 of width bytes of each luma row of the first picture, whether it equals the embedded golden md5, and the UsingHardwareAcceleratedVideoDecoder property. With no vectors/embedded_vectors.h it reports golden=absent and skips (2). av01/mp4v report skip: no format-description path is implemented for them.

probe/probe_vt.c T03 'vt.encode.<codec>.<w>x<h>': avc1/hvc1 at 640x480, 1280x720, 1920x1080 and jpeg at 640x480; reports create status, EncoderID, UsingHardwareAcceleratedVideoEncoder, the status of AverageBitRate=w*h*3, RealTime=true, MaxKeyFrameInterval=30, AllowFrameReordering=false; encodes 30 probe_fill_nv12 pictures in 420v CVPixelBuffers, CompleteFrames; frames, bytes, keyframes (from the NotSync attachment), ms/frame, first failing status; then decodes the produced samples with a VTDecompressionSession from the first sample's format description and reports PSNR of the first and last picture against the source (pass needs >= 30 dB).

probe/probe_vt.c T03b 'vt.encode.{hvc1,avc1}.{req-hw,en-hw}': VTCompressionSessionCreate with {Require|EnableHardwareAcceleratedVideoEncoder: true}; reports the create status (and the EncoderID when it succeeds). A create failure is a result, not a test failure.
probe/probe_vt.c T04 'vt.transfer': VTPixelTransferSession 1920x1080 420v -> 640x360 BGRA; status and ms.

probe/probe_img.c T05 'img.write/read.{jpeg,heic,png}': a 1024x768 RGBA gradient through CGBitmapContextCreate/CGBitmapContextCreateImage, CGImageDestinationCreateWithData + AddImage + Finalize, then CGImageSourceCreateWithData + CreateImageAtIndex, width/height and the mean of the decoded pixels drawn into a bitmap context; JPEG and HEIC additionally decode WP09's golden files and check their dimensions. T06 'img.cmphoto': dlopen(CMPhoto) and dlsym of CMPhotoCompressionSessionCreate and CMPhotoJPEGCreateJPEGFromCVPixelBuffer, nothing called.

probe/probe_audio.c T07 'audio.aac': LPCM 44.1 kHz mono 16-bit -> AAC ('aac ') with kAudioConverterEncodeBitRate 64000 -> LPCM; 1 s of a 440 Hz sine; reports create/set/encode status, packets, bytes, decoded frames, the RMS of input and output and their difference in dB; passes when within 3 dB and at least half the samples came back.

probe/com.nord2.videoprobe.plist: Label com.nord2.videoprobe, ProgramArguments [/usr/libexec/n2vt_probe], RunAtLoad true, UserName root, ProcessType Background, no KeepAlive, StandardErrorPath /private/var/db/nord2-video/probe.stderr.
probe/symbols.txt: the 137 symbols the probe imports, as '<install name>\t_<symbol>', in 8 images. run_tests.sh proves that the set of imports of the linked binary is exactly this file.

probe/test/run_tests.sh: host runner test (ASan+UBSan, 40 checks), JSON validation by python3, iOS arm64 compile of all five sources with -Werror against test-local scaffolding (probe/test/iosinc, NOT sdk/), link of build/WP07/ios/n2vt_probe from TBDs generated from probe/symbols.txt with LC_MAIN and an exact import-set check, and the plist check. 46 checks, ~10 s.

The probe also builds and links through WP01's real build_ios.sh: 'PROBE_NO_AV=1 bash gpu/video/build_ios.sh' compiled 5 sources and linked build/ios/n2vt_probe (95072 bytes, 137 undefined symbols all covered by sdk/lib/*.tbd).

If fork() itself fails (a sandbox that denies process-fork), probe_run runs the test in the same process instead, reports the field nofork=1, and keeps its fields in a 1 MiB in-memory buffer with the same record framing so nothing can block. This fallback has no timeout; it is compile-tested only.
not_done: No part of probe_vt.c, probe_img.c or probe_audio.c has ever run: they call Apple frameworks and this machine is Linux. They compile for arm64-apple-ios16.0 with -Werror and link; their first execution is phone cycle C1.

T02 av01 / mp4v: no CMVideoFormatDescription construction is implemented for AV1 or MPEG-4 Part 2 (an av1C/ESDS extension would be needed), so those two tests always report skip. WP09 embeds only H.264 and HEVC streams.
T05's 'dimensions must match the manifest' check reads WP09's embedded arrays; the manifest file itself is not parsed.
The 1080p encode tests are 30 frames each (timeout 180 s). Total probe wall time on the phone is unmeasured; if C1 overruns, drop the 1080p cases first.
probe_main.c's gate, 45 s sleep and directory creation cannot be exercised on the host (the paths are absolute and the host has no /private/var/db); only probe_next_index is host-tested.
The HEVC/H.264 decode tests have never been run against the phone's dyld cache, so whether VTCopyVideoEncoderList works in the probe process (sandbox) is unknown; a failure is reported, not hidden.

commands.last_line: size: 95072 bytes   (build/ios/n2vt_probe, 137 undefined symbols all covered by sdk/lib/*.tbd)

known_risks: Every Apple prototype below is written from documentation memory, not from an SDK header (the rules forbid opening one). A wrong argument order in VTCompressionSessionEncodeFrame, VTDecompressionSessionCreate or AudioConverterFillComplexBuffer would crash the test's child process; the runner reports that as 'crash' with a signal, so it cannot take the probe down, but the measurement is lost.

VTCompressionSessionCreate is declared with the VTCompressionOutputCallbackRecord passed by pointer; that is the iOS 16 signature. The callback's 5 arguments (refcon, sourceFrameRefCon, status, infoFlags, sampleBuffer) are as documented.

VTSessionCopyProperty is used with the text 'UsingHardwareAcceleratedVideoEncoder' / '...Decoder' and 'EncoderID' if the private constants are not exported; a wrong key returns kVTPropertyNotSupportedErr, which the test reports as hw=-1.
The probe forks before each test. Apple frameworks are not documented as fork-safe; the fallback is the same test run as its own process, but that is not implemented.
Forking 22 times and creating VT/ImageIO/Audio sessions in each child costs time; the C1 budget (2-4 min) has not been measured.

isHardwareAccelerated of the encoder list is read from the key 'IsHardwareAccelerated' unless kVTVideoEncoderList_IsHardwareAccelerated resolves; if neither is right the value is reported as -1 (unknown), not wrong.
probe_img.c writes HEIC through ImageIO, which on this phone goes to CMPhoto and may insist on a hardware encoder; a finalize=0 there is the expected measurement, not a bug in the test.
The nofork fallback is untested: forcing fork() to fail on the host is not reliable. Its code path compiles and shares probe_say/fields_parse with the tested path.
